description: Elections Commission - Declare that Mr. S. Mariyadasan as a member of the Jaffna Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Jaffna Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a municipal council seat, including the nomination of a replacement member by a political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This content falls squarely within the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it involves electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
